codexlint.onSave.enabled.description: Run codexlint security analysis when a file is saved.

codexlint.onSave.debounceMs.description: Delay before launching analysis after save.

codexlint.onSave.maxFileBytes.description: Skip files larger than this size in bytes.

codexlint.codex.command.description: Executable used to run codex analysis.

codexlint.codex.args.description: Base arguments passed to the configured analysis command before model/skill arguments and prompt injection.

codexlint.codex.model.description: Optional model identifier. Leave empty to let the CLI/tool default decide.

codexlint.codex.modelArg.description: Flag used to pass codexlint.codex.model to the analysis command.

codexlint.codex.skills.description: Optional list of skills to pass to the analysis command (one flag per entry). Also available in prompt via {{skillsList}}.

codexlint.codex.skillArg.description: Flag used to pass each skill from codexlint.codex.skills.

codexlint.codex.promptTransport.description: How the rendered prompt is passed to the analysis command.

codexlint.codex.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for analysis command output.

scripts.compile: tsc -p ./ && node prepare-dist.mjs && cd dist && vsce package --no-dependencies
